name: CA19-9 Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of CA19-9 using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of Cancer Antigen 19-9 (CA19-9) in serum, plasma or whole blood. The test is utilized for the adjunctive diagnosis of pancreatic cancer. For professional and laboratory use only.
